titolo: OpenAI partners with Chile to promote responsible AI adoption
descr: OpenAI announced a partnership with the Government of Chile on 17 November 2026.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced a partnership with the Government of Chile on 17 November 2026.
The collaboration aims to support responsible AI adoption across the country.
It will focus on building AI skills within the public sector.
Local startups will receive assistance to develop AI applications.
The initiative seeks to foster a thriving AI ecosystem in Chile.
perche: For AI users, the partnership could bring more reliable public services powered by AI. For developers, especially those exploring free or locally hosted models, the support for startups may create new opportunities to build and deploy applications.
